title: FX Brief — 26 Aug 2026
intro:
Risk-on AUD strength dominates amid broad commodity currency gains, while JPY weakness persists despite modest USD consolidation.
💪 CURRENCY RANKING
AUD +0.35% — Commodity rally and risk appetite driving outperformance across all pairs
CHF +0.21% — Safe-haven bid partially offset by risk-on environment, gaining vs USD
USD +0.05% — Neutral consolidation after recent strength, mixed performance across majors
CAD -0.14% — Lagging commodity peers despite oil support, weakness vs AUD prominent
EUR -0.03% — Range-bound trade, underperforming commodity bloc but holding vs USD
GBP -0.07% — Mild weakness intraday, losing ground to EUR and commodity currencies
NZD -0.29% — Underperforming despite risk-on tone, diverging from AUD strength
JPY -0.49% — Broad-based weakness continues, intervention concerns fading near 159.00
